title: A first-order temperature singularity for a stable radial continuum gas
exact_target: Does there exist a bounded continuous radial pair potential phi on $R^3$, stable in the sense $sum_{i<j}$ $\phi (|x_i-x_j|)\geq -BN$, with $|\phi (r)|\leq Cr^{-3-1/32}$, and a nonempty density interval I, such that one $\beta _c\in [7/8,9/8]$ is a strict temperature derivative jump of the finite canonical free-cube thermodynamic free energy for every $\rho \in I$?
